decisive_spans.text: High-resolution CT of the temporal bones showed an irregularly enhancing mass in the right ear canal, middle ear cavity, and mastoid air cells

response.rationale: D2 (Cholesteatoma) is strongly supported by the clinical presentation of aural fullness, otorrhea, and hearing loss, along with imaging showing an irregularly enhancing mass in the ear canal, middle ear cavity, and mastoid air cells. D4 (Squamous cell carcinoma of the external auditory canal) is also supported by the polypoid mass and purulent discharge, but the imaging findings of the mass extending into the middle ear cavity and mastoid air cells, along with the history of aural fullness, are more characteristic of cholesteatoma. D1 (Aggressive papillary middle ear tumor) is less specific. D3 (Middle Ear Cholesteatoma) is contradicted by the presence of a polypoid mass occluding the external auditory canal.
